# Ferndesk

AI-native help center platform that writes and updates documentation automatically using your codebase, support tickets, and changelogs.

Your help center is out of date. Customers ask questions you've answered 100 times. Support tickets pile up. You know you should update the docs, but who has time?

Ferndesk fixes this with an AI agent called Fern. It connects to your codebase, support inbox, and changelogs. It finds gaps in your docs. It writes articles for you. You review and publish. Done in minutes, not hours.

Every week, Fern audits your help center. It spots stale content, broken links, and missing topics. When your product changes, your docs change too. Customers find answers. Your inbox stays quiet. You ship product instead of writing docs.
